name: Oreo Milkshake
desc: Thick vanilla ice cream shake blended with Oreo cookies.

source.title: Oreo Milkshake
source.evidence: Same three core ingredients (6 Oreos blended, vanilla ice cream, milk) and the same pulse-the-cookies-first method; SugarHero uses far less milk and adds toppings.

steps: Let the ice cream sit out until slightly softened, 10 to 15 minutes, so it blends without extra milk. Chill 2 glasses in the freezer meanwhile.
Add the Oreos to the blender and pulse a few times on low to break them into small pieces.
Add the milk and ice cream and blend on low, then medium, until smooth and pourable, 30 to 45 seconds. Do not overblend or it turns thin.
Pour into the chilled glasses and serve right away.
tips: For bigger cookie bits, blend with 4 Oreos and pulse the last 2 in at the end (The Kitchn's method).
